checked: Dexalot Portfolio bridge on Base (DefiLlama slug dexalot-portfolio, module dexalot-bridge, TVL 488k). Contracts from Dexalot's own deployment API (https://api.dexalot.com/privapi/trading/deployment?contracttype=Portfolio&env=production-multi-base; the adapter URL privapi/deployment is 404, use privapi/trading/deployment): PortfolioMain 0x50901EeE5cBDafdF410299c16bA598B2D01b6627 (eth_getCode nonempty, VERSION()=0x...322e372e30 = '2.7.0' matches API), PortfolioBridgeMain 0x246c87368580acd6E9ca46Bf112aD91978389634 (getPortfolio() returns PortfolioMain). Docs: Dexalot/dexalot-docs docs/en/contracts/PortfolioMain.md, PortfolioBridgeMain.md. No function anyone can call for reward: depositToken/depositNative are user actions; processXFerPayload reverts for a fresh address (called only via LzBridge 0x29c1160f14084939f35ae556a95b80ebcafe7fa1 -> PortfolioBridgeMain.processPayload -> PortfolioMain, role-gated); collectBridgeFees/collectNativeBridgeFees/refundNative owner-only. The only keeper-like action is delivering L1->Base withdrawals, which happens on LayerZero's shared Executor302 0x2cca08ae69e0c44b18a57ab2a87644234daebae4 (impl 0x2c17394025421a670aae4dd24b3e2fd44cf98890, execute302((address,(uint32,bytes32,uint64),bytes32,bytes,bytes,uint256)) = 0xcfc32570) - onlyRole(ADMIN_ROLE): eth_call of a real input from 0x1111...1111 reverts 'AccessControl: account missing role', from a known relayer it succeeds. 7 deliveries in 7 days by 5 relayer EOAs (0xe93685f3... x3, 0x0e183f1d..., 0xd0dcacd0..., 0x2858e862..., 0x73a063c9...); callTracer on all 7 shows zero native value to the caller (relayers are reimbursed off-chain by LayerZero/Dexalot), so no on-chain reward even for a role holder. 40 outbound DEPOSIT messages (user txs, no keeper action).
